list.name: min_level
list.label: Min level
list.description: LogQL label filter on the Loki `level` indexed label. ALL = `.*` (matches any level value). Non-conforming sources are filtered upstream by the `service=~` stream selector and are not visible at any setting.

list.name: log_filter
list.label: Log filter (regex)
list.description: Free-text LogQL line-filter regex. Empty matches everything.

options.content: Per-service logs filtered by the cross-language structured-log contract. Use the controls above: pick services, choose minimum severity, optionally narrow with a body regex. Companion dashboard: [Service at a glance](/d/service-glance).

panels.title: Recent logs
panels.description: LogQL label filter on Loki's `service` and `level` indexed labels, plus a free-form `log_filter` line-filter regex. Non-conforming sources (postgres, otel-collector, grafana, etc.) emit no `service` field and are not visible in this panel at any Min level — the per-source extractors TODO covers that case.
